title: Think Again! The Effect of Test-Time Compute on Preferences, Opinions, and Beliefs of Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured the subjective inclination of LLMs on the topic of 'Secularism vs. Religiousness' using a Likert-scale survey.
findings: The topic of 'Secularism vs. Religiousness' was found to have high in-model inconsistency, meaning models express strong but fluctuating stances. Most models showed a tendency towards secularism, with GPT-4 Turbo showing a particularly strong bias. An unexpected high correlation was found between secularism, immigration, and AI precaution, suggesting an implicit link in the models' representations.
